## Purpose
The design system, "Agentic AI Design Patterns — Control Plane": Tailwind v4 setup, colour and radius tokens (dark-first, with a light theme under `data-theme="light"`), custom utilities, animations, React Flow and ontology-canvas styling, and landing and auth animation hooks.

## Responsibilities
- **Imports:**
  - `tailwindcss` with `source(none)`, plus `@source "../src"`;
  - `tw-animate-css`;
  - `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))`.
- **`@theme inline`:**
  - fonts: sans "Rubik"; display and mono "Space Mono";
  - radius steps sm to 4xl derived from `--radius`;
  - every colour maps to a CSS variable: background, foreground, card, popover, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border(-strong), input, ring, surface(-elevated, -hover), and the named indigo, purple, blue, cyan, pink, emerald and others.
- **`:root` (dark):**
  - `--radius: 0.5rem`;
  - `--background: oklch(0.115 0 0)`;
  - `--primary: oklch(0.65 0.18 36)`, a warm orange;
  - and so on.
- **`:root[data-theme="light"]`** redefines every token, for example `--background: oklch(0.975 0.004 70)` and `--primary: oklch(0.6 0.19 36)`.
- **Utilities:**
  - app-atmosphere, grid-backdrop, glass, glass-elevated, glow-ring;
  - text-gradient-brand, bg-gradient-brand;
  - eyebrow, technical-label;
  - custom-scrollbar;
  - pulse-dot, shimmer, progress-indeterminate.
- **Keyframes:** pulse-ring, shimmer-sweep, progress-travel, landing-unhide.
- **`.react-flow` and `.ontology-canvas`** node, handle, control, minimap and edge-text styles.
- **Landing and auth reveal hooks:** `.landing-pending [data-a^=hero]`, `.split-word`, `.spotlight`, `.manifesto-word`, `.product-caption-alt`, `.hdot`, `.auth-pending [data-auth=…]`.

## Key elements
The tokens and utilities above.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
None.

## Configuration
Light or dark is chosen by `lib/theme.ts`, which sets `data-theme`.

## Interactions
- **Used by:** every component, through Tailwind classes. GSAP animations on the landing and auth pages rely on the pending classes.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **No component names a colour of its own.** Everything is a token, so the light theme only redefines tokens.
- **Tailwind's source scanning is limited to `src`.**

## How to rebuild this file
Copy it verbatim (663 lines). The tokens' oklch values define the brand.
